method: Two independent blind drafts (A: Read every document's title and agency, then swept abstracts/actions via keyword and agency filters (FAA, DOT, DHS/TSA, aviation, drug testing, Denver/Salt Lake), a 14 CFR / 49 CFR 40 / 49 CFR 1500-1699 citation sweep, and a manual check of opaque or abstract-less titles, with govinfo full-text reads of ~50 candidates. Every airworthiness directive's applicability paragraph was checked against the E175 (ERJ 170-200, GE CF34-8E) and A319/A320 fleet; flags require a change to what the airline or its fleet must do. | B: Scripted review of all 466 documents (titles, agencies, types, abstracts) with agency and aviation keyword screens plus a manual read of the remaining title list; full text from govinfo for every FAA AD, airspace and fee document touching a possible fleet match. AD model lists were compared against the E175/A319/A320 fleet.) reconciled by a third blind agent: agreements kept and merged; every disagreement re-read in full text on govinfo against the profile; genuine 50/50 calls dropped; one-sided traps kept only if they look relevant at first glance; every flag quote re-validated verbatim against the source.
